turgenev.definition: n. Russian writer of stories and novels and plays (1818-1883)
turgenev.translation: n. 屠格涅夫（俄国作家名）

turgescence.translation:
n. 肿, 肿胀, 浮夸
[医] 肿胀, 肿大

turgescent.definition: a. Becoming turgid or inflated; swelling; growing big.
turgescent.translation:
a. 肿的, 浮夸的
[医] 肿胀的, 肿大的

turgid.definition:
s ostentatiously lofty in style
s abnormally distended especially by fluids or gas
turgid.translation:
a. 肿的, 浮夸的
[医] 充满的, 胀满的

turgidity.translation: n. 肿胀, 浮肿,浮夸

turgidly.translation: adv. 肿胀地; 复杂地; 夸张地

turgor.definition: n (biology) the normal rigid state of fullness of a cell or blood vessel or capillary resulting from pressure of the contents against the wall or membrane
turgor.translation: n. 细胞(组织)的膨胀, 肿胀,浮夸,夸张

turgot.definition: n. French economist who in 1774 was put in control of finances by Louis XVI; his proposals for reforms that involved abolishing feudal privileges made him unpopular with the aristocracy and in 1776 he was dismissed (1727-1781)
